headline: A 2011 executive order directing federal agencies to simplify how they deliver services and to improve customer service to the public.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order tells federal agencies to make their services easier to use and to improve how they serve the public. No summary was provided, so the specific steps, deadlines, and requirements are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: Agencies are directed to streamline how they deliver services and improve customer service.

who_it_affects.group: People who use federal government services
who_it_affects.how: The order aims to change how the public is served when dealing with federal agencies, though the details are not given in the title.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed April 27, 2011; no separate start date is given in the available information.
